name: Gillespie Pass Circuit
why: Up the Young valley, over a 1,600 m snow-grass ridge facing Mount Awful and down to Siberia Hut, with a day trip to Crucible Lake under Mount Alba.
book: Book Young and Siberia huts. The Young valley turn-off is 2.5 km north of Makarora on SH6; the circuit ends on Wilkin Road south of Makarora, about 7 km away by SH6, so arrange a lift or leave time for the road. Jet boats can take you across the Makarora or out from Kerin Forks, and planes fly out of Siberia Valley: book them before you go.
water: Hut taps are untreated: boil before use. Fill up in the upper Young before the pass: no water until well over it.
dangers: River crossings are the main risk: several people have drowned here. Do not cross the Makarora, Young or Wilkin when high or after rain.
The Makarora can look clear and still flow too fast to cross.
Avoid the Young valley in heavy rain: a 2007 landslide dam in the North Branch could burst.
Snow and avalanche risk on the pass in winter and spring; slippery snow grass on the descent.
turnaround: If rain is forecast at Young Hut or the pass is in cloud, wait in the hut rather than cross; the Young River Link Track avoids the first Makarora crossing.

points.name: Young valley turn-off, SH6
points.note: Cross the stile and follow orange poles to the Young-Makarora confluence; ford the Makarora only if it is low.

points.name: Young Hut
points.note: First night, 20 km and 6-7 h in, at 550 m, past the swing bridge at Young Forks. No camping at the hut.

points.name: Gillespie Pass
points.note: The track climbs a snow-grass spur to a 1,600 m ridge with Mount Awful ahead, then drops steeply through snow-grass basins.

points.name: Siberia Hut
points.note: Second night at 630 m on the Siberia flats. Crucible Lake under Mount Alba is a day trip: 7 km, 3-4 h from the hut by the DOC brochure.

points.name: Wilkin Road, Makarora
points.note: 22 km, 7-8 h from Siberia Hut: down Siberia Gorge to the Wilkin by Kerin Forks, along the Wilkin flats, across the Makarora and out by Wilkin Road to SH6.
